contract_evidence: same ancestor + lineage seed produces exact ancestor identity
same parent + mutation seed + offspring index + policy produces exact descendant result
offspring index and mutation seed alter the deterministic event stream
zero-mutation offspring preserves genotype while receiving a new individual identity
probability-one probe mutates all five P1B-S1 ecological traits
all effective mutation deltas remain inside explicit per-trait steps and biological ranges
160-generation chain preserves parent pointers, one lineage_id and valid genomes
mutation and lineage source contains no predefined species/biome/presentation/authority dependency
truth_boundary: P1B-S1 adds inheritance/provenance research only. It does not itself encode environment-specific selection, species classes, biome roles, presentation coupling, authority, persistence or network replication and does not modify accepted P1A equations.
next: ECO.P1B-S2 Spatial Selection Baseline is opened. Identical mutation candidates must be exposed to contrasting accepted P1A environments so differences arise from selection rather than site-specific mutation.
